summary: BUG-208/208b Expense Module Unit Price Fixes - All 4 bug fixes VERIFIED. Tested Bulk Editor price persistence, Bulk Editor price clearing, Unit Prices tab delete confirmation modal, and Stock Master inline edit price clearing. All core functionality working correctly.

test_results.BUG-208 Fix 1 - Bulk Editor Price Persis: PASS - Changed 'ac reparing' price from 1 to 500, saved, closed Bulk Editor, re-opened, and verified price persisted as 500. 'Saved' toast appeared correctly.
test_results.BUG-208 Fix 1b - Bulk Editor Price Clear: PASS - Cleared 'ac reparing' price (set to empty), saved, closed Bulk Editor, re-opened, and verified price shows '—' (empty). Price was successfully removed.
test_results.BUG-208b Fix A - Unit Prices Tab Delete: PASS - On Unit Prices tab, clicked edit on priced item, cleared price field, clicked ✓ confirm, and 'Remove Unit Price?' confirmation modal appeared with Cancel and Remove buttons. Modal text: 'This item will move back to Not Priced Yet. You can set a new price later.'
test_results.BUG-208b Fix B - Stock Master Inline Edi: PASS - On Stock Master tab, edited 'almond' item (had ₹12.00 price), cleared price field, clicked save, and price was removed (shows '—'). 'Item updated' toast appeared.
test_results.Regression - Adding New Unit Price: PARTIAL - Set Price button clicked, price input filled with value 25, but confirm button was disabled. This may be expected behavior if quantity field also needs to be filled. The UI shows QTY and PRICE fields.
test_results.Regression - Data Restoration: PASS - Successfully restored 'ac reparing' price to ₹1.00 and 'almond' price to ₹12.00 using the Set Price flow.

action_items: MINOR: Verify that the 'Set Price' flow on Unit Prices tab requires both QTY and PRICE fields to be filled before confirm button is enabled. Current behavior may be correct but should be documented.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG-208 Fix (Line 160-172 ExpenseSetupPanel.jsx): fetchAll() now correctly cross-joins pricedItems onto allItems using priceMap, ensuring unitPriceAmount survives refresh. This fixes the price revert issue.
BUG-208 Fix (Line 420-439 ExpenseBulkEditor.jsx): Price clearing in price-only path now calls deleteUnitPrice() when user clears the field, instead of showing an error.
BUG-208b Fix A (Line 875-887 ExpenseSetupPanel.jsx): handleEditPrice() now opens delete confirmation modal when price is cleared (empty/zero), matching the trash button behavior.
BUG-208b Fix B (Line 570-587 ExpenseSetupPanel.jsx): saveEditItem() now calls deleteUnitPrice() when user clears price in Stock Master inline edit, instead of blocking with an error.
Code quality is good - consistent use of data-testid attributes, proper error handling, and optimistic UI updates with rollback on failure.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 bug fixes verified, 1 regression test partial)

seed_data_creation: Test modified prices for 'ac reparing' and 'almond' items. Data was restored to original state after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-208/208b fixes are fully verified. The expense module's unit price management now correctly handles: (1) price persistence in Bulk Editor after save/refresh, (2) price clearing in Bulk Editor, (3) delete confirmation modal when clearing price in Unit Prices tab, (4) price clearing in Stock Master inline edit. The app has a 20-25 second loading screen after login. Use in-app navigation (sidebar) instead of direct URL navigation to preserve session state.
